notes: kb/Work PB5702: COBOL 2002 is judged by its own Annex C.2 (TR 10176:2001), no longer by the 2014 table derived from 2023's Annex B. a) every character of C.2.1 and C.2.2 is an extended letter of the UTF-16 compile-time set (the 2002 repertoire is a subset of the 2014 or 2023 tables, AnnexBCDriftTests). b) the special characters of C.2.1 (U+00B5, U+0559, U+2102 ...) and C.2.2's MIDDLE DOT, and the combining characters (the rows 2014's Annex B.3.1 labels combining, within the 2002 repertoire, because 2002 Annex C labels none), are the medial class: COBOL2773 first or last, accepted inside a word; a character outside Annex C.2 (Syriac, Thaana, Sinhala ...) is COBOL2773. Witnesses at --std 2002: pb5702 accepted test (X, micro sign, y and L, middle dot, L accepted; output ONE TWO) and the refused pb5702 last-in-a-word test (COBOL2773 for Xmicro). c) and d) are the fold and the length rules, held by the siblings GR3 and the GR4c length rule.
